description: Stage 2 is the exact change-contract corpus. It removes most historical battle-test artifacts because the approved stage-one review bundle should already lock the diagnosis. It keeps the current framework surfaces most likely to change in the final improvement packet: control-plane docs and templates, framework contracts, current runtime/review/release schemas, modeling and hybrid contract docs, the current official swarm runbooks, runtime scripts, and the tests that currently encode role/state/gate/release semantics. The April 12 retrospective also stays attached because it is compact, current, and directly relevant to exact supervisory and scientific-program architecture decisions. Ad-hoc local operator workflow notes are intentionally excluded so stage 2 designs the supervision layer from the official framework surfaces and the approved stage-one diagnosis rather than from interim operator workarounds. The current project contract remains reference-only because it is a battle-tested instance embedding rather than the default redesign target.
